user.title: Add a Gate Pass access point
user.description: Configure one Home Assistant action. Add the integration again for additional access points.

data_description.guest_port: Access points may share one port and public URL, or use separate ports and URLs.
data_description.public_base_url: For example {example_url}. Leave empty for an automatically generated local URL.
data_description.notification_services: Select one or more devices. Unlisted classic notify.* services can be entered manually.
data_description.notification_events: Choose which pass lifecycle events should notify you.

error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.
error.invalid_notification_service: Enter a notify.* service or leave the field empty.
error.invalid_service: The action must use the domain.service format.

list_access_points.name: List access points
list_access_points.description: Returns all loaded Gate Pass access points for cards and automations.

create_pass.name: Create pass
create_pass.description: Creates a temporary guest link with an optional use limit.

config_entry_id.name: Access point
config_entry_id.description: Target access point. Optional when only one is configured.

label.name: Label
label.description: Name of the guest or purpose of the pass.

duration_hours.name: Validity
duration_hours.description: Number of hours for which the pass remains valid.

max_uses.name: Maximum uses
max_uses.description: Set to 0 for unlimited uses until expiry.

valid_from.name: Valid from
valid_from.description: Optional date and time from which the pass can be used.

list_activity.name: List activity
list_activity.description: Returns the persistent activity history without guest secrets or network identifiers.

export_activity.name: Export activity
export_activity.description: Returns the selected access point activity as a privacy-conscious CSV file.

clear_activity.name: Clear activity
clear_activity.description: Permanently removes all stored Gate Pass activity records.

pass_id.name: Pass ID
pass_id.description: ID of the pass to revoke.

revoke_all.name: Revoke all passes
revoke_all.description: Immediately revokes all active passes for one access point.
